_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: C. K. Scott Moncrieff (1889-1930): Proust, Stendhal, the Song of Roland, Beowulf, Abelard and Heloise. Only translations first published before 1931 AND available in a pre-1931 printing are shelved; the later Proust volumes survive online only in 1932+ reprints and wait in _pending. US public domain (pre-1931 publication); UK public domain since 2001 (d. 1930). Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 9); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_surname_note: Never the bare 'moncrieff': A. R. Hope Moncrieff (travel books) and W. T. Moncrieff (plays) are on the same catalogue pages.

moncrieff-abelard: The Letters of Abelard and Heloise

moncrieff-proust-swanns-way.scan_edition: Project Gutenberg 7178 (clean text); Henry Holt, New York, 1922

moncrieff-proust-guermantes-way.scan_edition: Project Gutenberg 73425 (clean text), made from a Modern Library printing that lists The Past Recaptured (1932), so the printing is 1932 or later; the text is Seltzer's 1925 (copyright line kept). Adam's call, DIGEST-C round 9.

moncrieff-stendhal-abbess-of-castro.work: The Abbess of Castro and Other Tales
moncrieff-stendhal-abbess-of-castro.scan_edition: Boni and Liveright, New York, MCMXXVI (1926), raw OCR. The '1930' above the half-title is a handwritten owner's or library date, not an imprint.

moncrieff-abelard-and-heloise.work: The Letters of Abelard and Heloise
moncrieff-abelard-and-heloise.scan_edition: Alfred A. Knopf, New York, March 1926 (raw OCR); first published London 1925

moncrieff-stendhal-armance.scan_edition: Boni and Liveright, New York, MCMXXVIII (1928), raw OCR

_pending.moncrieff-proust-cities-of-the-plain: 1927/1929: US PD, but the only open scans (citiesofplain0000prou_b6a6, dli.ernet.16336) are Chatto reprints of 1960 and 1971.
_pending.moncrieff-proust-the-captive: 1929: US PD, but captive00prourich is a Random House printing listing 1932 and 1947; dli.ernet.16281 is a 1957 Chatto reprint.
_pending.moncrieff-proust-sweet-cheat-gone: 1930: US PD since 2026, but every open scan is a 1957+ Random House or 1970 Vintage printing (copyright-renewal lines).
_pending.moncrieff-pirandello-shoot: 1926: shoot0000luig is the 1934 'Nobel Prize Edition'; shoot-luigi-pirandello is a Gutenberg-Australia text of unstated edition.
_pending.moncrieff-pirandello-old-and-young: 1928: only volume 2 is open (oldyoung02pira); volume 1 not found.
_pending.moncrieff-lauzun: Memoirs of the Duc de Lauzun (1928): translated jointly with Aldington and Rutherford; not checked.
_pending.moncrieff-stendhal-red-and-black: 1926: US PD. redblack0000mari_e9r8, _h6c2 and _z4c1 are all Modern Library printings by Random House (1931 or later; e9r8's back list carries Modern Library Giant numbers). redblack0000unse_p8m8 is the 1926 first printing but volume one only; volume two not found open.

_excluded.moncrieff-past-recaptured: Time Regained / The Past Recaptured is Stephen Hudson's and Frederick Blossom's, not Scott Moncrieff's (he died in 1930).

_name_words_note: Translator name only: fetch_shelf.py treats it as the identity check, so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.
_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
